name: Multi-Agent Orchestration
purpose: Execute multi-agent work as a dependency DAG with isolated workspaces, capped retries and delegation depth, diversified reviewers, and evidence-gated completion decided by CI verdicts.
inputs: Approved workflow recipe with stages, owners, and handoff schemas
Dependency DAG with nodes, depends-on edges, and computed critical path
Isolation mechanism and caps ledger for retries, depth, and reviewer diversity
outputs: Merged, CI-green result for the Goal with full evidence traceability
Archived run bundle with DAG, caps ledger, reviews, and CI logs
Post-run report naming cap hits, escalations, and reviewer coverage
stop_conditions: All DAG nodes closed with evidence and CI green on merge-back
Caps exhausted on a node; parked and escalated with a written record
